architectureRules.tenantProduct: Tenant identity, runtime, memory, skills, work, policy, approvals, rationale, evidence, basic audit/export, and runtime entitlement enforcement remain tenant product authority.
architectureRules.installationOperations: Installer, bootstrap, upgrade, backup, restore, installation health, and installation-owner operations are separate from tenant product and fleet authority.
architectureRules.fleetCommercial: Cross-installation administration, catalog curation or promotion, Stripe/provider settlement, usage reconciliation, and commercial authority belong to the fleet-commercial plane.
architectureRules.runtimeEntitlements: Runtime entitlements and tenant-owned budget controls are tenant product even when commercial provider projections or Stripe settlement are fleet-commercial.
